topics.date_filter: client-side Atom updated timestamps; never lastUpdatedDate search field
topics.activation_approval: 2026-09-29: User requested HTML-first collection with same-version official PDF originals only when arXiv HTML is unavailable, renewed the request, and approved the protected AGENTS.md edit. Apply this policy to the existing daily Cron; queue the 2 previously approved, HTML-unavailable targets. No preprocessing or automatic Wiki compilation. Earlier deletion approval is historical and grants no new deletion authority.
topics.no_change_policy: record successful zero-result run; no external notification
topics.overlap_policy: one global atomic directory lock; skip if busy; never automatically steal a stale lock
topics.missed_run_policy: next actual run discovers from persisted successful-search checkpoint, clamped to first-run floor; no one-run-per-missed-day replay
topics.backfill_policy: no new discovery earlier than first-run 24-hour floor; oldest eligible pending first; cap is per KST date; existing approved missing IDs in existing_target_pdf_fallback_ids may be captured without moving the discovery checkpoint
topics.failure_policy: preserve failed HTML/PDF staging and pending on search/download/identity/hash failure; after 3 consecutive core failures set local safety_block; confirmed HTML unavailable permits same-version PDF capture, not transport-error bypass; confirmed absence of both formats stays pending until a 7-day retry; count only verified stored originals as captured
topics.safety_pause_scope: local execution gate, not an automatic Hermes cron pause
